description: NASA's catalogue of every confirmed planet beyond the Solar System, more than 6,000 of them, run by Caltech for NASA. Search planets by size, mass, orbit, temperature, distance, star type, discovery method, facility or year; get a planet or a whole star system in full; list the planets added or updated each week; count planets by method or year; follow TESS planet candidates; translate Kepler and K2 names; or run your own ADQL query. A trigger runs when a new planet is confirmed. No account or API key required.
